_note_ansoneki: The ANSONEKI heading sits right after the author's hand-typed contents list, and its one-line bios are too short for the contents-list dropper to see it as a real section, so it is dropped with the list. Put it back above the bios.
_note_toc: The contents page lists only headings it knows as units (UNIT/TOPIC/CHAPTER/CHIBALU/CIPATI), not KAPETULU, so it came out empty: list every section heading (ANSONEKI + the 11 chapters), as in the Kiikaonde ECE TG.
_note_edit: Chapter-heading slips in the manuscript: the colon of Chapter 3 sits before its number (every other chapter is "KAPETULU N: ..."), and Chapter 10 has a double space.
_note_strands: From Chapter 3 on, the B./C. strand lines (KUTACHIKA KUDIZA KUTAÑA / KUSONEKA) are Word auto-lettered list items, not headings as in Chapters 1-2, so they printed as list lines and stranded at page feet. Make every one a heading, lettered as the manuscript letters them (KUTAÑA is always B, KUSONEKA always C).
